alert.message: OpenClaw gateway probe is responding on 127.0.0.1:18789, but openclaw gateway status reports the systemd service as stopped/out-of-date and recommends reinstalling the service config. During this check, a SIGUSR1 restart signal was also triggered manually.
alert.action: Audit gateway supervision path (PM2 vs systemd), reinstall the service only if systemd is intended, and confirm logs after the triggered restart.
